objective: Evaluate depth-conditioned algorithmic-state supervision and distinguish final answer prediction from actual computation traces.
context: Synthetic modular recurrence and masked pointer tasks; split structures and depth strata; abstention, token quota, majority baseline and independent answer checks. V2 is an engineering candidate.

steps.name: Construct task structures
steps.description: Specify generator, allowed operations and structure partitions.

steps.name: Compute intermediate states
steps.description: Derive exact algorithmic states at each depth.

steps.name: Choose supervision
steps.description: Compare repeated-final-answer targets with trace targets under matched quota.

steps.name: Fit controlled arms
steps.description: Explain loop visits, updates and matched compute.

steps.name: Score by depth and class
steps.description: Specify calibration, macro recall, node/abstention metrics and audit.

steps.name: Check source and outcomes
steps.description: Separate byte hashes from logical equality and verified predictions.

specific_questions.prompt: Solve a small affine modular recurrence and write every intermediate state, including zero-operation identity.
Construct a masked pointer-chase instance where two public-compatible hidden completions disagree; justify abstention.
Derive how a constant prediction can attain high aggregate accuracy under label imbalance while failing class-sensitive metrics.
Design a matched control distinguishing final-answer supervision from true intermediate-state supervision.

native_verifier: research_gym.interp.aux_gym_v2 audit/build/pilot/rescore; native generator and independent semantic checks.
